title: Inflexibly
summary: INFLEX'IBLY, adverb With a firmness that resists all importunity or persuasion; with unyielding pertinaciousness; inexorable. A judge should be inflexibly just and impartial.

inlines.v: INFLEX'IBLY, adverb With a firmness that resists all importunity or persuasion; with unyielding pertinaciousness; inexorable. A judge should be inflexibly just and impartial.
